data.name: Tip_BlockUpdates
data.value: Map the Legrand firmware-update servers to 127.0.0.1 so the unit can't silently download and flash an over-the-air update that would wipe these changes. Off by default; reversible by reflashing the stock firmware.

data.name: Hint_BlockUpdates
data.value: Protects the mod from being wiped by an official update — but the unit will no longer receive updates or security fixes while blocked.

data.name: Tip_KeepSig
data.value: Carry the original .sig signature sidecars into the rebuilt .fwz instead of dropping them. Off by default (fquinto removes them), because the signature for the modified payload becomes stale.

data.name: Hint_KeepSig
data.value: Default is to remove them (like fquinto), which is the tested path. Keeping a stale signature can make a signature-checking updater reject the archive.

data.value: Override the default MQTT topic names. Leave unchanged for the Home Assistant defaults.

data.name: Tip_MqttTcpdump
data.value: Leave unchecked to stream events straight from the local OpenWebNet gateway (no tcpdump, no resident Python). Tick this only if the bridge shows no bus activity — it forces the legacy tcpdump capture.

data.name: Hint_MqttTcpdump
data.value: Default: a direct OpenWebNet monitor socket, lighter on the device. The tcpdump path is used automatically as a fallback if the gateway is unreachable.

data.name: Tip_MqttHaDiscovery
data.value: Publish retained MQTT discovery configs so the bridge's entities (connectivity, bus dump, last key) appear in Home Assistant automatically, with no manual YAML. Read-only — no command entity is created.

data.name: Hint_MqttHaDiscovery
data.value: On by default: the bridge's entities (connectivity, bus, last key) appear in Home Assistant automatically, as one device. Untick to skip it; a later build with the same device id then clears them from the broker.

data.name: Tip_MqttHaNodeId
data.value: Identifier for the Home Assistant device and its entities. Use a distinct value per unit so several bridges can coexist on one broker. Letters, digits, '_' or '-' only.
